g.text: Six-layer decision-support architecture transforming raw offset records and real-time active well context into evidence-backed hazard guidance.
Unstructured shift logs, mud sheets, completion files
Depth progression, ROP, WOB, Torque, ECD
Mud Loss, Stuck Pipe, Kick detection
Live eRTMAC & WITSML Operational Data Stream Integration
Planned connector to ingest live drilling telemetry (MWD/LWD, Mud Logging gas channels, real-time WITSML depth updates) directly into Layer 4.
Current prototype uses explainable heuristic relevance scoring and interval intersection hazard screening. It does not claim deep learning prediction models or autonomous rig control.
